## 任务元信息
本任务当前标题是占位截断：「A 不可适配失败根因探针」。正式开工前，先调用一次 `set_task_meta` 工具回填元信息：`title` = 用不超过 50 个字总结任务正文（平文本，无 markdown，覆盖占位标题）；`tag` = 从下面的固定词表选至多 1 个最贴切的类别，判不出就不传 `tag`：
- bug：修坏的东西
- feature：新功能
- improvement：改进既有功能
- refactor：重构（不改行为）
- docs：文档
- chore：杂务/依赖/配置

Use the read tool to load a skill's file when the task matches its description.
When a skill file references a relative path, resolve it against the skill directory (parent of SKILL.md / dirname of the path) and use that absolute path in tool commands.

A 不可适配失败根因探针

探针任务：写一行说明

function.name: read
function.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

anyOf.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)
Maximum number of lines to read

function.name: bash
function.description: Execute a bash command in the current working directory. Returns stdout and stderr. Output is truncated to last 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). If truncated, full output is saved to a temp file. Optionally provide a timeout in seconds.

anyOf.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, no default timeout)

function.name: edit
function.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

function.name: write
function.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

function.name: save_memory
function.description: Save a one-fact memory entry for yourself (the agent running this step). Use it only when the task instructions ask for it or a lesson is clearly worth keeping. Quota 100 per agent.

sourceTodoId.description: Optional source todo id; defaults to the running task.

function.name: delete_memory
function.description: Delete one of your memory entries by id.

function.name: memories
function.description: List your own memory entries.

function.name: attachment
function.description: Fetch an attachment referenced by a task spec or message. Spec tokens of the form ![name](attachment:<teamId>/<id>.<ext>) embed an attachment; call with the bare <id> (the part before the extension). Returns the file content (utf8 for text/* / json / xml, base64 for images / pdf).

function.name: set_task_meta
function.description: Set the title and category tag of the task you are currently working on. Call exactly once before starting work: title = a concise summary of the task spec (50 chars max, plain text, no markdown); tag = one name from the fixed tag vocabulary listed in your instructions (omit it when none fits).

tag.description: Optional tag name from the fixed vocabulary.

function.name: create_skill
function.description: Create a team skill as a folder in the team skills directory. Requires the 「创建技能」permission switch on your agent row. The SKILL.md frontmatter name and description must match the declared values.

name.description: Skill name; also the folder name and the SKILL.md frontmatter name.

description.description: One-line skill description; must match the SKILL.md frontmatter.

path.description: File path inside the skill folder.

files.description: Skill files; must include SKILL.md.

function.name: update_skill
function.description: Update an existing team skill by id. Requires the「更新技能」permission switch on your agent row. Listed files are overwritten, unlisted files are kept; include a new SKILL.md to change the frontmatter (including renaming).

name.description: Declared skill name; must match the SKILL.md frontmatter.

description.description: Declared description; must match the SKILL.md frontmatter.

path.description: File path inside the skill folder.

files.description: Files to overwrite; include SKILL.md to change frontmatter.

A 不可适配失败根因探针

探针任务：写一行说明

function.name: read
function.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

anyOf.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)
Maximum number of lines to read

function.name: bash
function.description: Execute a bash command in the current working directory. Returns stdout and stderr. Output is truncated to last 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). If truncated, full output is saved to a temp file. Optionally provide a timeout in seconds.

anyOf.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, no default timeout)

function.name: edit
function.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

function.name: write
function.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

function.name: save_memory
function.description: Save a one-fact memory entry for yourself (the agent running this step). Use it only when the task instructions ask for it or a lesson is clearly worth keeping. Quota 100 per agent.

sourceTodoId.description: Optional source todo id; defaults to the running task.

function.name: delete_memory
function.description: Delete one of your memory entries by id.

function.name: memories
function.description: List your own memory entries.

function.name: attachment
function.description: Fetch an attachment referenced by a task spec or message. Spec tokens of the form ![name](attachment:<teamId>/<id>.<ext>) embed an attachment; call with the bare <id> (the part before the extension). Returns the file content (utf8 for text/* / json / xml, base64 for images / pdf).

function.name: set_task_meta
function.description: Set the title and category tag of the task you are currently working on. Call exactly once before starting work: title = a concise summary of the task spec (50 chars max, plain text, no markdown); tag = one name from the fixed tag vocabulary listed in your instructions (omit it when none fits).

tag.description: Optional tag name from the fixed vocabulary.

function.name: create_skill
function.description: Create a team skill as a folder in the team skills directory. Requires the 「创建技能」permission switch on your agent row. The SKILL.md frontmatter name and description must match the declared values.

name.description: Skill name; also the folder name and the SKILL.md frontmatter name.

description.description: One-line skill description; must match the SKILL.md frontmatter.

path.description: File path inside the skill folder.

files.description: Skill files; must include SKILL.md.

function.name: update_skill
function.description: Update an existing team skill by id. Requires the「更新技能」permission switch on your agent row. Listed files are overwritten, unlisted files are kept; include a new SKILL.md to change the frontmatter (including renaming).

name.description: Declared skill name; must match the SKILL.md frontmatter.

description.description: Declared description; must match the SKILL.md frontmatter.

path.description: File path inside the skill folder.

files.description: Files to overwrite; include SKILL.md to change frontmatter.

## 任务元信息
本任务当前标题是占位截断：「A 不可适配失败根因探针」。正式开工前，先调用一次 `set_task_meta` 工具回填元信息：`title` = 用不超过 50 个字总结任务正文（平文本，无 markdown，覆盖占位标题）；`tag` = 从下面的固定词表选至多 1 个最贴切的类别，判不出就不传 `tag`：
- bug：修坏的东西
- feature：新功能
- improvement：改进既有功能
- refactor：重构（不改行为）
- docs：文档
- chore：杂务/依赖/配置

A 不可适配失败根因探针

探针任务：写一行说明

function.name: read
function.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

anyOf.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)
Maximum number of lines to read

function.name: bash
function.description: Execute a bash command in the current working directory. Returns stdout and stderr. Output is truncated to last 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). If truncated, full output is saved to a temp file. Optionally provide a timeout in seconds.

anyOf.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, no default timeout)

function.name: edit
function.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

function.name: write
function.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

function.name: save_memory
function.description: Save a one-fact memory entry for yourself (the agent running this step). Use it only when the task instructions ask for it or a lesson is clearly worth keeping. Quota 100 per agent.

sourceTodoId.description: Optional source todo id; defaults to the running task.

function.name: delete_memory
function.description: Delete one of your memory entries by id.

function.name: memories
function.description: List your own memory entries.

function.name: attachment
function.description: Fetch an attachment referenced by a task spec or message. Spec tokens of the form ![name](attachment:<teamId>/<id>.<ext>) embed an attachment; call with the bare <id> (the part before the extension). Returns the file content (utf8 for text/* / json / xml, base64 for images / pdf).

function.name: set_task_meta
function.description: Set the title and category tag of the task you are currently working on. Call exactly once before starting work: title = a concise summary of the task spec (50 chars max, plain text, no markdown); tag = one name from the fixed tag vocabulary listed in your instructions (omit it when none fits).

tag.description: Optional tag name from the fixed vocabulary.

function.name: create_skill
function.description: Create a team skill as a folder in the team skills directory. Requires the 「创建技能」permission switch on your agent row. The SKILL.md frontmatter name and description must match the declared values.

name.description: Skill name; also the folder name and the SKILL.md frontmatter name.

description.description: One-line skill description; must match the SKILL.md frontmatter.

path.description: File path inside the skill folder.

files.description: Skill files; must include SKILL.md.

function.name: update_skill
function.description: Update an existing team skill by id. Requires the「更新技能」permission switch on your agent row. Listed files are overwritten, unlisted files are kept; include a new SKILL.md to change the frontmatter (including renaming).

name.description: Declared skill name; must match the SKILL.md frontmatter.

description.description: Declared description; must match the SKILL.md frontmatter.

path.description: File path inside the skill folder.

files.description: Files to overwrite; include SKILL.md to change frontmatter.

A 不可适配失败根因探针

探针任务：写一行说明

function.name: read
function.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

anyOf.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)
Maximum number of lines to read

function.name: bash
function.description: Execute a bash command in the current working directory. Returns stdout and stderr. Output is truncated to last 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). If truncated, full output is saved to a temp file. Optionally provide a timeout in seconds.

anyOf.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, no default timeout)

function.name: edit
function.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

function.name: write
function.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

function.name: save_memory
function.description: Save a one-fact memory entry for yourself (the agent running this step). Use it only when the task instructions ask for it or a lesson is clearly worth keeping. Quota 100 per agent.

sourceTodoId.description: Optional source todo id; defaults to the running task.

function.name: delete_memory
function.description: Delete one of your memory entries by id.

function.name: memories
function.description: List your own memory entries.

function.name: attachment
function.description: Fetch an attachment referenced by a task spec or message. Spec tokens of the form ![name](attachment:<teamId>/<id>.<ext>) embed an attachment; call with the bare <id> (the part before the extension). Returns the file content (utf8 for text/* / json / xml, base64 for images / pdf).

function.name: set_task_meta
function.description: Set the title and category tag of the task you are currently working on. Call exactly once before starting work: title = a concise summary of the task spec (50 chars max, plain text, no markdown); tag = one name from the fixed tag vocabulary listed in your instructions (omit it when none fits).

tag.description: Optional tag name from the fixed vocabulary.

function.name: create_skill
function.description: Create a team skill as a folder in the team skills directory. Requires the 「创建技能」permission switch on your agent row. The SKILL.md frontmatter name and description must match the declared values.

name.description: Skill name; also the folder name and the SKILL.md frontmatter name.

description.description: One-line skill description; must match the SKILL.md frontmatter.

path.description: File path inside the skill folder.

files.description: Skill files; must include SKILL.md.

function.name: update_skill
function.description: Update an existing team skill by id. Requires the「更新技能」permission switch on your agent row. Listed files are overwritten, unlisted files are kept; include a new SKILL.md to change the frontmatter (including renaming).

name.description: Declared skill name; must match the SKILL.md frontmatter.

description.description: Declared description; must match the SKILL.md frontmatter.

path.description: File path inside the skill folder.

files.description: Files to overwrite; include SKILL.md to change frontmatter.

function.name: read
function.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

anyOf.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)
Maximum number of lines to read

function.name: bash
function.description: Execute a bash command in the current working directory. Returns stdout and stderr. Output is truncated to last 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). If truncated, full output is saved to a temp file. Optionally provide a timeout in seconds.

anyOf.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, no default timeout)

function.name: edit
function.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

function.name: write
function.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

function.name: save_memory
function.description: Save a one-fact memory entry for yourself (the agent running this step). Use it only when the task instructions ask for it or a lesson is clearly worth keeping. Quota 100 per agent.

sourceTodoId.description: Optional source todo id; defaults to the running task.

function.name: delete_memory
function.description: Delete one of your memory entries by id.

function.name: memories
function.description: List your own memory entries.

function.name: attachment
function.description: Fetch an attachment referenced by a task spec or message. Spec tokens of the form ![name](attachment:<teamId>/<id>.<ext>) embed an attachment; call with the bare <id> (the part before the extension). Returns the file content (utf8 for text/* / json / xml, base64 for images / pdf).

function.name: set_task_meta
function.description: Set the title and category tag of the task you are currently working on. Call exactly once before starting work: title = a concise summary of the task spec (50 chars max, plain text, no markdown); tag = one name from the fixed tag vocabulary listed in your instructions (omit it when none fits).

tag.description: Optional tag name from the fixed vocabulary.

function.name: create_skill
function.description: Create a team skill as a folder in the team skills directory. Requires the 「创建技能」permission switch on your agent row. The SKILL.md frontmatter name and description must match the declared values.

name.description: Skill name; also the folder name and the SKILL.md frontmatter name.

description.description: One-line skill description; must match the SKILL.md frontmatter.

path.description: File path inside the skill folder.

files.description: Skill files; must include SKILL.md.

function.name: update_skill
function.description: Update an existing team skill by id. Requires the「更新技能」permission switch on your agent row. Listed files are overwritten, unlisted files are kept; include a new SKILL.md to change the frontmatter (including renaming).

name.description: Declared skill name; must match the SKILL.md frontmatter.

description.description: Declared description; must match the SKILL.md frontmatter.

path.description: File path inside the skill folder.

files.description: Files to overwrite; include SKILL.md to change frontmatter.

A 不可适配失败根因探针

探针任务：写一行说明

function.name: read
function.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

anyOf.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)
Maximum number of lines to read

function.name: bash
function.description: Execute a bash command in the current working directory. Returns stdout and stderr. Output is truncated to last 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). If truncated, full output is saved to a temp file. Optionally provide a timeout in seconds.

anyOf.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, no default timeout)

function.name: edit
function.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

function.name: write
function.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

function.name: save_memory
function.description: Save a one-fact memory entry for yourself (the agent running this step). Use it only when the task instructions ask for it or a lesson is clearly worth keeping. Quota 100 per agent.

sourceTodoId.description: Optional source todo id; defaults to the running task.

function.name: delete_memory
function.description: Delete one of your memory entries by id.

function.name: memories
function.description: List your own memory entries.

function.name: attachment
function.description: Fetch an attachment referenced by a task spec or message. Spec tokens of the form ![name](attachment:<teamId>/<id>.<ext>) embed an attachment; call with the bare <id> (the part before the extension). Returns the file content (utf8 for text/* / json / xml, base64 for images / pdf).

function.name: set_task_meta
function.description: Set the title and category tag of the task you are currently working on. Call exactly once before starting work: title = a concise summary of the task spec (50 chars max, plain text, no markdown); tag = one name from the fixed tag vocabulary listed in your instructions (omit it when none fits).

tag.description: Optional tag name from the fixed vocabulary.

function.name: create_skill
function.description: Create a team skill as a folder in the team skills directory. Requires the 「创建技能」permission switch on your agent row. The SKILL.md frontmatter name and description must match the declared values.

name.description: Skill name; also the folder name and the SKILL.md frontmatter name.

description.description: One-line skill description; must match the SKILL.md frontmatter.

path.description: File path inside the skill folder.

files.description: Skill files; must include SKILL.md.

function.name: update_skill
function.description: Update an existing team skill by id. Requires the「更新技能」permission switch on your agent row. Listed files are overwritten, unlisted files are kept; include a new SKILL.md to change the frontmatter (including renaming).

name.description: Declared skill name; must match the SKILL.md frontmatter.

description.description: Declared description; must match the SKILL.md frontmatter.

path.description: File path inside the skill folder.

files.description: Files to overwrite; include SKILL.md to change frontmatter.

function.name: read
function.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

anyOf.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)
Maximum number of lines to read

function.name: bash
function.description: Execute a bash command in the current working directory. Returns stdout and stderr. Output is truncated to last 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). If truncated, full output is saved to a temp file. Optionally provide a timeout in seconds.

anyOf.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, no default timeout)

function.name: edit
function.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

function.name: write
function.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

function.name: save_memory
function.description: Save a one-fact memory entry for yourself (the agent running this step). Use it only when the task instructions ask for it or a lesson is clearly worth keeping. Quota 100 per agent.

sourceTodoId.description: Optional source todo id; defaults to the running task.

function.name: delete_memory
function.description: Delete one of your memory entries by id.

function.name: memories
function.description: List your own memory entries.

function.name: attachment
function.description: Fetch an attachment referenced by a task spec or message. Spec tokens of the form ![name](attachment:<teamId>/<id>.<ext>) embed an attachment; call with the bare <id> (the part before the extension). Returns the file content (utf8 for text/* / json / xml, base64 for images / pdf).

function.name: set_task_meta
function.description: Set the title and category tag of the task you are currently working on. Call exactly once before starting work: title = a concise summary of the task spec (50 chars max, plain text, no markdown); tag = one name from the fixed tag vocabulary listed in your instructions (omit it when none fits).

function.name: create_skill

name.description: Skill name; also the folder name and the SKILL.md frontmatter name.

path.description: File path inside the skill folder.

files.description: Skill files; must include SKILL.md.

A 不可适配失败根因探针

探针任务：写一行说明

function.name: read
function.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

anyOf.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)
Maximum number of lines to read

function.name: bash
function.description: Execute a bash command in the current working directory. Returns stdout and stderr. Output is truncated to last 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). If truncated, full output is saved to a temp file. Optionally provide a timeout in seconds.

anyOf.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, no default timeout)

function.name: edit
function.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

function.name: write
function.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

function.name: save_memory
function.description: Save a one-fact memory entry for yourself (the agent running this step). Use it only when the task instructions ask for it or a lesson is clearly worth keeping. Quota 100 per agent.

sourceTodoId.description: Optional source todo id; defaults to the running task.

function.name: delete_memory
function.description: Delete one of your memory entries by id.

function.name: memories
function.description: List your own memory entries.

function.name: attachment
function.description: Fetch an attachment referenced by a task spec or message. Spec tokens of the form ![name](attachment:<teamId>/<id>.<ext>) embed an attachment; call with the bare <id> (the part before the extension). Returns the file content (utf8 for text/* / json / xml, base64 for images / pdf).

function.name: set_task_meta
function.description: Set the title and category tag of the task you are currently working on. Call exactly once before starting work: title = a concise summary of the task spec (50 chars max, plain text, no markdown); tag = one name from the fixed tag vocabulary listed in your instructions (omit it when none fits).

tag.description: Optional tag name from the fixed vocabulary.

function.name: create_skill
function.description: Create a team skill as a folder in the team skills directory. Requires the 「创建技能」permission switch on your agent row. The SKILL.md frontmatter name and description must match the declared values.

name.description: Skill name; also the folder name and the SKILL.md frontmatter name.

description.description: One-line skill description; must match the SKILL.md frontmatter.

path.description: File path inside the skill folder.

files.description: Skill files; must include SKILL.md.

function.name: update_skill
function.description: Update an existing team skill by id. Requires the「更新技能」permission switch on your agent row. Listed files are overwritten, unlisted files are kept; include a new SKILL.md to change the frontmatter (including renaming).

name.description: Declared skill name; must match the SKILL.md frontmatter.

description.description: Declared description; must match the SKILL.md frontmatter.

path.description: File path inside the skill folder.

files.description: Files to overwrite; include SKILL.md to change frontmatter.

function.name: read
function.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

anyOf.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)
Maximum number of lines to read

function.name: bash
function.description: Execute a bash command in the current working directory. Returns stdout and stderr. Output is truncated to last 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). If truncated, full output is saved to a temp file. Optionally provide a timeout in seconds.

anyOf.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, no default timeout)

function.name: edit
function.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

function.name: delete_memory

function.name: attachment
function.description: Fetch an attachment referenced by a task spec or message. Spec tokens of the form ![name](attachment:<teamId>/<id>.<ext>) embed an attachment; call with the bare <id> (the part before the extension). Returns the file content (utf8 for text/* / json / xml, base64 for images / pdf).

function.name: set_task_meta
function.description: Set the title and category tag of the task you are currently working on. Call exactly once before starting work: title = a concise summary of the task spec (50 chars max, plain text, no markdown); tag = one name from the fixed tag vocabulary listed in your instructions (omit it when none fits).

function.name: create_skill

path.description: File path inside the skill folder.

files.description: Skill files; must include SKILL.md.

function.name: update_skill
function.description: Update an existing team skill by id. Requires the「更新技能」permission switch on your agent row. Listed files are overwritten, unlisted files are kept; include a new SKILL.md to change the frontmatter (including renaming).

function.name: read
function.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

anyOf.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)
Maximum number of lines to read

function.name: bash
function.description: Execute a bash command in the current working directory. Returns stdout and stderr. Output is truncated to last 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). If truncated, full output is saved to a temp file. Optionally provide a timeout in seconds.

anyOf.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, no default timeout)

function.name: edit
function.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

function.name: write
function.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

探针任务：写一行说明

function.name: read
function.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

anyOf.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)
Maximum number of lines to read

function.name: bash
function.description: Execute a bash command in the current working directory. Returns stdout and stderr. Output is truncated to last 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). If truncated, full output is saved to a temp file. Optionally provide a timeout in seconds.

anyOf.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, no default timeout)

function.name: edit
function.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

function.name: write
function.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

function.name: save_memory
function.description: Save a one-fact memory entry for yourself (the agent running this step). Use it only when the task instructions ask for it or a lesson is clearly worth keeping. Quota 100 per agent.

sourceTodoId.description: Optional source todo id; defaults to the running task.

function.name: delete_memory
function.description: Delete one of your memory entries by id.

function.name: memories
function.description: List your own memory entries.

function.name: attachment
function.description: Fetch an attachment referenced by a task spec or message. Spec tokens of the form ![name](attachment:<teamId>/<id>.<ext>) embed an attachment; call with the bare <id> (the part before the extension). Returns the file content (utf8 for text/* / json / xml, base64 for images / pdf).

function.name: set_task_meta
function.description: Set the title and category tag of the task you are currently working on. Call exactly once before starting work: title = a concise summary of the task spec (50 chars max, plain text, no markdown); tag = one name from the fixed tag vocabulary listed in your instructions (omit it when none fits).

tag.description: Optional tag name from the fixed vocabulary.

function.name: create_skill
function.description: Create a team skill as a folder in the team skills directory. Requires the 「创建技能」permission switch on your agent row. The SKILL.md frontmatter name and description must match the declared values.

name.description: Skill name; also the folder name and the SKILL.md frontmatter name.

description.description: One-line skill description; must match the SKILL.md frontmatter.

path.description: File path inside the skill folder.

files.description: Skill files; must include SKILL.md.

function.name: update_skill
function.description: Update an existing team skill by id. Requires the「更新技能」permission switch on your agent row. Listed files are overwritten, unlisted files are kept; include a new SKILL.md to change the frontmatter (including renaming).

name.description: Declared skill name; must match the SKILL.md frontmatter.

description.description: Declared description; must match the SKILL.md frontmatter.

path.description: File path inside the skill folder.

files.description: Files to overwrite; include SKILL.md to change frontmatter.

本任务当前标题是占位截断：「C 旋钮移除回流探针」。正式开工前，先调用一次 `set_task_meta` 工具回填元信息：`title` = 用不超过 50 个字总结任务正文（平文本，无 markdown，覆盖占位标题）；`tag` = 从下面的固定词表选至多 1 个最贴切的类别，判不出就不传 `tag`：
- bug：修坏的东西
- feature：新功能
- improvement：改进既有功能
- refactor：重构（不改行为）
- docs：文档
- chore：杂务/依赖/配置

C 旋钮移除回流探针

探针任务：写一行说明
请重新规划该任务，输出更新后的方案。

function.name: read
function.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

anyOf.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)
Maximum number of lines to read

function.name: bash
function.description: Execute a bash command in the current working directory. Returns stdout and stderr. Output is truncated to last 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). If truncated, full output is saved to a temp file. Optionally provide a timeout in seconds.

anyOf.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, no default timeout)

function.name: edit
function.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

function.name: write
function.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

function.name: save_memory
function.description: Save a one-fact memory entry for yourself (the agent running this step). Use it only when the task instructions ask for it or a lesson is clearly worth keeping. Quota 100 per agent.

sourceTodoId.description: Optional source todo id; defaults to the running task.

function.name: delete_memory
function.description: Delete one of your memory entries by id.

function.name: memories
function.description: List your own memory entries.

function.name: attachment
function.description: Fetch an attachment referenced by a task spec or message. Spec tokens of the form ![name](attachment:<teamId>/<id>.<ext>) embed an attachment; call with the bare <id> (the part before the extension). Returns the file content (utf8 for text/* / json / xml, base64 for images / pdf).

function.name: set_task_meta
function.description: Set the title and category tag of the task you are currently working on. Call exactly once before starting work: title = a concise summary of the task spec (50 chars max, plain text, no markdown); tag = one name from the fixed tag vocabulary listed in your instructions (omit it when none fits).

tag.description: Optional tag name from the fixed vocabulary.

function.name: create_skill
function.description: Create a team skill as a folder in the team skills directory. Requires the 「创建技能」permission switch on your agent row. The SKILL.md frontmatter name and description must match the declared values.

name.description: Skill name; also the folder name and the SKILL.md frontmatter name.

description.description: One-line skill description; must match the SKILL.md frontmatter.

path.description: File path inside the skill folder.

files.description: Skill files; must include SKILL.md.

function.name: update_skill
function.description: Update an existing team skill by id. Requires the「更新技能」permission switch on your agent row. Listed files are overwritten, unlisted files are kept; include a new SKILL.md to change the frontmatter (including renaming).

name.description: Declared skill name; must match the SKILL.md frontmatter.

description.description: Declared description; must match the SKILL.md frontmatter.

path.description: File path inside the skill folder.

files.description: Files to overwrite; include SKILL.md to change frontmatter.
